parameters.content:
## THE DASHBOARD'S DATA SOURCE
GET http://localhost:5678/webhook/dashboard-data?key=YOUR_KEY

Reads all four CRM tabs, computes every number the dashboard shows, and returns one JSON payload with CORS enabled so a local HTML file can fetch it.

Open dashboard/index.html in a browser, paste the same key into its settings, and it refreshes on a timer.

nodes.name: Dashboard Data Webhook
nodes.notes: GET, so the browser sends no preflight. The key travels as a query parameter rather than a header for the same reason.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Cadence values must match RE-04 and RE-05, otherwise the follow-up queue shown here will not match what actually gets sent.

nodes.name: Read Projects
nodes.notes: executeOnce, or this would re-read the tab once per lead row coming out of the previous node.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ error: 'unauthorized', hint: 'Append ?key=<DASHBOARD_KEY> from the Config node.' }) }}

nodes.name: Build Dashboard Payload
nodes.notes: The browser only renders. Every count, rate, funnel stage and follow-up decision is computed here, using the same cadence rules as RE-04 and RE-05.
